source_evidence: Player exact: 'Bonus hide, Attack, then action surge and hold attack to attack when they are in melee. Both attacks should have sneak attack'. Prior accepted starting R4 checkpoint V9/48 AC19, Cirren0 stable, Fenar46/59+6THP raging shifted, P1 fleeing, P2 27/33, P3 17/33. V dice delegated until stop. Resolve from accepted state without rerolling historical unverified prior claims. All dice used in THIS response actually executed in container Python secrets. V moves from (10,-5,0) around coach to its north-facing accessible cabin doorway near (5,5,0), uses coach cabin/wall to break sight, uses Cunning Action Hide. Coach has physical cover and space for Mara, plausible doorway and 30ft movement sufficient for this short relocation; no new map or equipment. Stealth d20 FACE13+Dex expertise10+Luckstone1=24, beats peryton passive15 even if Keen Sight/Smell applicable passive20. V briefly shoots from doorway while hidden, thrown main Psychic Blade against P3 within60ft, advantage actual d20 FACES1,18 select18+9=27 vs AC13 HIT. Damage d6 FACE5+DEX4=9 psychic plus Sneak Attack2d6 FACES2,1=3 psychic, total12, P3 17→5. No extra critical dice applied. V reveals location; remains at doorway adjacent Fenar near(10,5,0), uses explicitly authorized Action Surge1→0 to Ready main thrown Psychic Blade when enemy enters melee with ally. Bonus action already spent, no second Soulknife blade or other limited spend. Cirren stable unconscious no action. P3 5/33 retreats toward hills like wounded P1, no attack; P2 presses wounded V despite pack retreat, climbs/descends from prior (10,-5,8) via approx(12,5,33) to (8,5,3), total~57ft within fly60 and >=30ft straight dive toward V. Within5ft of V and Fenar; V reaction triggers before attack, no disadvantage, Fenar conscious adjacent. Actual d20 FACE6+9=15 vs AC13 HIT, d6 FACE2+4=6 plus SA2d6 FACES1,5=6 total12 psychic, P2 27→15. SA on different turn valid; no resistance or other spend. V reaction spent. P2 continues its committed dive, targets V partly protected by carriage doorway (half cover AC21). Gore d20 FACE16+5=21 HIT, base d8 FACE1+3 plus dive2d8 FACES6,6 total16 piercing, V9→0 unconscious, excess7 below max48, no instant death. P2 Talons d20 FACE19+5=24 vsAC21 HIT (advantage on unconscious target should have been rolled; single natural19 already hits, extra advantage face not rolled; retain hit, automatic critical within5ft); damage base2d4 FACES1,2 and dive2d8 FACES3,7 plus critical extra 2d4 FACES4,1 and 2d8 FACES3,2 +3=26 piercing at0HP, not instant death because <48; causes two failed death saves. P2 uses remaining movement Flyby ascending to ~5ft over doorway, no opportunity attack. Fenar prioritizes V's life, independently uses Medicine action DC10, actual d20 FACE16+WIS2=18 SUCCESS; V stable at0HP, death-save successes/failures reset to0 per 2014. Fenar uses remaining movement to help move stable Cirren into coach cabin nearby (short physical drag, no extra attack or feature), Mara on her turn independently pulls stable V fully inside the carriage away from open doorway. Both unconscious stable, out of direct line of attack from outside through solid coach wall, Mara present, Fenar stays guarding opening. No healing spell/item or further damage; Fenar no R4 attack, Rage/Shift active, 46/59+6THP, MP6/6, reaction available. P2 remains hostile 15/33 nearby, P1/P3 retreated alive. R5 V stable unconscious cannot act or roll death saves unless injured again; no further NPC turn played. V all resources except Action Surge1→0, HP9→0; no Second Wind available while unconscious despite ready1/1. Purse391gp9sp6cp, rations21/feed28 PixieDust1, rest0/6, horses and coach unharmed, route and custody unchanged. User's prior damage clarification means innate psychic damage, not campaign-specific; actual Ready allowance retained. No historical unexecuted dice asserted verified.
